newsitem.title: JAPAN: KPC 1997 term LPG freight set at $30/tonne - traders.
newsitem.headline: KPC 1997 term LPG freight set at $30/tonne - traders.

text.p: Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) has rolled over the current freight rate of $30 per tonne for Japanese buyers of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) for the first half of 1997, traders said on Thursday.
The $30 freight rate will be applied to full cargoes of around 40,000 tonnes while the rate for partial cargoes was set at $32.50 per tonne, they said.

Term freight rates for the second half of 1997, expected to be set by the end of June, are likely to be set lower than $30.00 per tonne as spot freight rates for LPG ships usually weaken in the summer due to slack demand, the traders said.
Japan is expected to import about 800,000 tonnes of term LPG cargoes from Kuwait in 1997, compared with an estimated 900,000 tonnes in 1996, they added.
